- [USER] User is considering canceling their Apple TV+ subscription.
- [USER] User is seeking help to review their viewing history on Apple TV+.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated that they cannot access the user's Apple TV+ account or viewing history directly.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a guide on how to review Apple TV+ viewing history on Apple devices and non-Apple devices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed steps for reviewing viewing history on Apple devices: Open the TV app, tap profile icon, tap "Purchased" or "Rented," scroll to "Apple TV+" section.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed steps for reviewing viewing history on non-Apple devices: Open the Apple TV app, sign in, navigate to "Library" or "Watch History."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested questions for the user to consider when reviewing their viewing history, such as frequency of watching, interest in upcoming content, and value of the subscription.
